Libra.last_act: 你在自己的公寓内原地停留，未发生位置移动或开门动作。

current_state.current_description: 已经入住地图上有明确坐标并接入道路网络的独立单间公寓。房间有窗、床、厨房角和直接通向街道的独立房门；巧克力作为普通食品存放在厨房橱柜中。Libra拥有仅本人可访问的私人邮箱。当前计划由Libra本人修订：毕业后找工作的目标继续保留；除考试学习外，还希望学习音乐或绘画等能够形成真实作品的技能。考试计划继续执行，但紧急程度为normal。刚从整夜深度睡眠中自然醒，睡眠质量极佳，身心得到充分休整，状态饱满，正准备开始今日的日程安排。

chocolate.description: Regular household chocolate stock kept in the kitchen cabinet for snacks and energy, not carried as an emergency survival item.

creative_learning.description: Learn a real creative skill beyond exam preparation, such as music or drawing, with the goal of producing work that exists outside Libra's own thoughts.

residence.layout: one main room with a window, a bed, and a compact kitchen corner
residence.entrance: private door opening directly onto willow_lane
residence.neighbor: yunru_apartment is next door but fully separate

mail_account.description: A private personal mail account. Yunru and other characters have no login or reading access unless Libra explicitly grants it.

Yunru.last_act: Yunru走出自己的公寓，来到相邻的Libra公寓门前，抬手轻轻敲了三下门，待门内有回应后开口询问Libra是否知道现在住在她隔壁的是自己。

current_state.current_description: 昨夜敲门询问Libra后返回自家公寓休息，清晨起床整理完毕，已打开家门踏上Willow Lane的步道，正沿着步道朝不远处的便利店行进，准备购买早餐。

chocolate.description: Household chocolate kept in Yunru's own kitchen cabinet as ordinary food.

job.description: Consider work after graduation if Yunru decides it fits her own goals; no job path is imposed by default.
